C9000280.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 280 (Unitary vertex operator algebras and conformal nets.; papers: Strongly rational unitary vertex operator algebras and conformal nets; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/280.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_ENERGY_AUDIT.statement: Independently verify or exactly refute a load-bearing assertion of build/02-energy.tex, without claiming the rest of the main theorem.

C_FILTRATION.statement: lem:energy-filtration: negative ordinary-mode monomials span each weight, with generator degree at most w-1 for C2(V)_w.

C_FIXED_CUTOFF.statement: The nested negative-product expansion has left/right mode indices as stated; in bounded-endpoint matrix elements every path has intermediate energy at most N+c_b and mode parameters O_b(N+1).

C_SHARP_NORMAL.statement: lem:sharp-normal-product: ||b[0]P_N|| <= C_b N^(w-1) X_(N+c_b)^(D_b) for every fixed negative-product generator monomial of weight w>=2.

C_PATH_CORE.statement: Universal finite Schur pairing, constrained tuple completion count, all-length iteration of columns of maps, and real-energy fixed-cutoff/index bounds.

C_GENERAL_COLUMN.statement: Theorem A: positively graded Hermitian mode families with the algebraic negative-product expansion satisfy the sharp zero-mode bound for every fixed nested monomial, with c_b=sum_i(d_i-1); no C2-cofiniteness or optimal energy bound is assumed.

C_C2_BOOTSTRAP.statement: On the vacuum of any simple unitary CFT-type C2-cofinite VOA, the filtration, positive trace start, both contractions and Mobius zero-mode transfer prove polynomial bounds and optimal order d-1 for all Hermitian quasi-primaries of weight d>=2, without rationality.

C_C2_LOCALITY.statement: Theorem B: a simple unitary CFT-type C2-cofinite VOA is CKLW-strongly local and generates an irreducible conformal net; originality and independent analytic review remain outstanding.

C_POLYNOMIAL.statement: The positive trace start, finite-generator filtration, commutator descent and additive-cutoff contraction give polynomial energy bounds on every already unitary grading-restricted module.

C_ZERO_TRANSFER.statement: eq:sharp-zero-mode: Mobius covariance and a dimension-independent spectral-tail estimate transfer the nonzero-mode bound to ||a[0]P_N|| <= C N^(d-1) X_(KN+c)^(d-1).

C_OPTIMAL.statement: thm:energy: every Hermitian quasi-primary of weight d>=2 has energy order d-1 on each grading-restricted unitary module, with polynomial dependence on its physical mode.

C_LOCALITY.statement: cor:locality: every simple unitary strongly rational VOA is CKLW-strongly local and generates an irreducible conformal net.

C_ANNULUS.statement: lem:charged-tools: transport-dominated charged fields with an already integrated source have polynomial bounds and bounded local annulus regularizations.

C_INTEGRATION.statement: thm:integration: every already unitary grading-restricted module has a unique compatible normal net action carrying the actual closed smeared fields.

C_FUSION_POSITIVE.statement: thm:positive-fusion: the canonical invariant form on M fusion N is positive definite for unitary finite-length inputs.

C_PERMUTATION.statement: lem:permutation-before-positivity: (P tensor P^vee) fusion_(V tensor V) T_sigma(V) is T_sigma(P fusion_V P^vee), without positivity assumptions on P.

C_STRONG_UNITARITY.statement: thm:strong-unitarity: every ordinary simple V-module admits a positive invariant Hermitian form.

C_CWX_EMBEDDING.statement: thm:cwx-embedding: integration is a fully faithful braided unitary tensor functor with dualizable finite-index image.

C_EXHAUSTION.statement: prop:exhaustion: every irreducible locally normal representation is the strong integration of an ordinary simple unitary V-module, without an energy-multiplicity or index assumption.

C_COMPLETE_RATIONALITY.statement: thm:rationality: A_V is completely rational and the CWX embedding exhausts its additive finite-index DHR category.

C_MAIN.statement: thm:main: strong locality, complete unitarity, strong module integration, complete rationality, and the braided unitary CWX equivalence.
